membrane_frame: Operator doctrine: mesh data with triangles is all we need -- the Visible Monkey 167-structure STL set is skin + skeleton + merged-muscle membranes of ONE adult-confirmed specimen, i.e. the three membrane layers arriving together as triangles. Intake is a translation of those triangles into the matter kernel format (triangles-are-weights), exactly the discipline matter_skeleton_import.py proved on the infant skeleton. Volume data (paired 3T MRI + CT) takes the proven volume->marching-cubes route; the 2,967 serial-section COLOR images are a third modality whose segmentation thresholds differ (color space, not density) -- hooked, named, and honestly marked untested.

rule_1_derivation_plan.note: Every number below is derived or cited; no parameter is authored. The synthetic test shapes' volumes are closed-form geometry, so the falsifiers compare physics to arithmetic, not to taste.
rule_1_derivation_plan.volume_law: V = |sum over faces (1/6) v_a . (v_b x v_c)| -- divergence theorem on the resident float32 triangles (the same triangles that go into the kernel blob).
rule_1_derivation_plan.area_law: A = sum over faces 0.5*|(v_b - v_a) x (v_c - v_a)|, accumulated exactly as the kernel validator does.
rule_1_derivation_plan.thickness_law: t = V/A -- the equivalent shell thickness that conserves the measured volume; the kernel's mass law A*t*rho then reproduces V*rho exactly. The only derived parameter, computed per compartment, never chosen.
rule_1_derivation_plan.mass_law: m = V * rho. Densities, cited (kg/mm^3 = kg/m^3 / 1e9): cortical bone 1900 kg/m^3 (ICRP Publication 89 (2002) reference value 1900; Cowin 'Bone Mechanics Handbook' / Currey 'Bones: Structure and Mechanics' adult wet range 1800-2100 -- consistent with the infant lane's cited upper anchor); skeletal muscle 1060 (ICRP 89; Mendez & Keys 1960, Metabolism 9:184-188, mammalian skeletal muscle density); skin 1109 (ICRP 89); articular cartilage 1060 (Yamada 1970 'Strength of Biological Materials'); organ soft tissue 1050 (ICRP Publication 23 (1975) Reference Man soft-tissue convention; ICRP 89 organ table spans ~1020-1070 for solid viscera -- the +-5% organ spread is a NAMED deviation, one material for all organ systems in v1).
rule_1_derivation_plan.mechanics_constants: The kernel requires young_modulus/yield/hardness_vickers per material. Where literature bands are wide, the band is cited and the chosen value marked PROVISIONAL in the material's own source string (the infant lane's pattern): bone E ~15-20 GPa (17), UTS ~80-150 MPa (100), HV 30-50 (40); muscle E passive ~0.01-0.1 MPa (0.05 PROVISIONAL), UTS ~0.1-0.2 MPa (0.14 Yamada), HV no direct literature value (0.05 PROVISIONAL, kernel-required field); skin E ~15-40 MPa (15 PROVISIONAL), UTS ~7-20 MPa (10, Yamada), HV 0.3 PROVISIONAL; cartilage E 7-25 MPa (10), UTS 13 MPa (Yamada). The MASS FALSIFIERS depend only on the densities above; the provisional mechanics fields gate later physics lanes, not this intake.
rule_1_derivation_plan.closed_mesh_law: A compartment is admissible only if every undirected edge of its triangle set is shared by exactly 2 triangles (closed manifold) -- the condition under which the divergence-theorem volume is the enclosed volume. Euler characteristic is NOT pinned (real bones have genus; chi = 2 - 2g is reported, not refused).
rule_1_derivation_plan.synthetic_volume_laws: box(a,b,c) = abc exactly; tetrahedron(edge a) = a^3/(6*sqrt(2)) exactly; octahedron(edge a) = (sqrt(2)/3) a^3 exactly; UV-sphere(r) approximates (4/3)pi r^3 from below (inscribed mesh); ellipsoid phantom volume = (4/3)pi*abc voxels x voxel volume exactly.
rule_1_derivation_plan.threshold_law: Volume-route threshold = 95th percentile of the measured density histogram (density_percentile law), computed per specimen at run time -- the morphosource_ct pipeline's law (p95 gave 118 signed units for 000875604 and 148 for 000875599: two specimens, two numbers, one law). A spec may pin an explicit threshold only by recording 'law': 'fixed' with the reason; the manifest records which law ran.
rule_1_derivation_plan.stage_law: adult is admitted only with age evidence from the collection record (age_months + age_source). The real specimen: female, 93 months (7.75 y), 4.3 kg, 758 mm -- Chung et al. 2019, J Korean Med Sci 34:e70 (PMCID PMC6393759), adult-confirmed at source; rhesus reproductive and dental maturity ~4-5 y (van Wagenen & Catchpole 1956), so 93 months is adult with margin. One creature, one life stage; mixing is refused.
